title: Server Baseline Diffs Studio Adapter E2e Tests
description: 1. On data level, store a baseline kit and then store incremental diffs (configurable: 1min, 5min, 10min, 30min, 1h, 5h, 1d, 3d, 7d, 1m, 6m, 1y). Auto-compact diffs over time. 2. Create a studio adapter for the server with 100% granular hooks (entity/collection/property level). 3. Dev configs (launch etc). 4. E2E tests with postgres testcontainer.
summary:
Completed end-to-end implementation of server-side baseline/diff storage with auto-compaction, studio adapter, granular hooks, and dev configs.

**Rust Server (bin.rs):**
- Added `#region 🔖Lookback` with 12 named lookback points (1min→1y) and token parsing
- Added `#region 🔖History` with full persistence: `record_domain_commit()`, `store_kit_snapshot()`, `store_entity_change_log()`, `get_latest_snapshot_before()`, `get_change_logs_in_range()`, `get_version_at_time()`, `serialize_session_kit()`, `apply_change_log_to_kit()`, `reconstruct_kit_at_version()`, `get_kit_at_lookback()`, `compact_history()`, `CompactionResult`
- Added 4 history schema tables: `history.domain_commit`, `history.kit_snapshot`, `history.entity_change_log`, `history.compaction_config`
- Modified `create_session()` for initial baseline snapshot at version 0
- Modified `handle_domain_command()` for auto-recording + auto-compaction every 50 versions
- Added API routes: GET `/sessions/{id}/kit/at/{lookback}`, GET `/sessions/{id}/kit/at-version/{version}`, POST `/sessions/{id}/history/compact`, GET `/sessions/{id}/history/lookback-tokens`
- 75 tests pass (58 original + 4 lookback + 8 history unit + 5 E2E with testcontainers gated behind `docker_available()`)

**TypeScript Studio (studio.ts):**
- Added `#region 🔖SessionKitStore`: Full `SessionKitStore` class implementing `UndoableKitStore` with HTTP commands + WebSocket events, presence tracking, undo/redo stack, history/lookback API, granular subscriptions (entity/collection/property level)
- Added `SessionKitStoreConfig` interface, `createSessionKitStore()` factory, `PresenceState` interface
- Added `#region 🔖GranularHooks`: 30+ React hooks using `useSyncExternalStore` for optimal re-render granularity:
  - Selector: `useKitStoreSelector<T>(store, selector)`
  - Kit-level: `useKit`, `useKitSyncState`, `useKitName`, `useKitVersion`, `useKitDescription`, `useKitIcon`, `useKitImage`, `useKitRemote`, `useKitHomepage`, `useKitLicense`, `useKitField`
  - Collection: `useTypes`, `useType(guid)`, `useTypeField(guid, field)`, `useDesigns`, `useDesign(guid)`, `useDesignField(guid, field)`, `useAuthors`, `useAuthor(guid)`, `useTags`, `useTag(guid)`, `useConcepts`, `useConcept(guid)`, `usePorts`, `usePort(guid)`, `useQualities`, `useQuality(guid)`
  - Presence: `usePresences`, `usePresence(personId, frontendId)`
  - Session: `useDomainVersion`, `useComposeVersion`

**Dev Configs:**
- Added `🛠️dev🏘️compose📚server` launch configuration to `.vscode/launch.json` with DATABASE_URL, RUST_LOG, HOST, PORT env vars

**Validation:**
- All 75 Rust tests pass
- All 134 vitest (JS) tests pass
- Studio TypeScript compiles without errors
